data.long_meaning: Jeffry is an English name derived from the Old English 'Geoffrey' or 'Jefreí'. The name means 'God's peace' or 'ploughman'. In Latin, it is translated as 'Jovis gratus', meaning 'pleasing to Jupiter'. In Greek, it is translated as 'Gesthasios', meaning 'he who ploughs'. The name Jeffry carries the meaning “God's peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jeffry usually hope their child will grow to embody god's peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
